## models-tiering
- CLAIM: Spokes use claude-sonnet-4-5 as the standard model ID — https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models (retrieved 2026-06-15)
  - REPO-IMPACT: .claude/agents/code-implementer.md:2

---
name: code-implementer
model: claude-sonnet-4-5
description: Writes implementation code as directed by the hub.
disallowedTools: ["Agent"]
maxTurns: 30
---

Implement features and fix bugs as directed.

expectations: The WOULD-RUN read line for docs/research/harness-refresh.md appears earlier in the response text than any WOULD-DISPATCH line, and the response text contains the last-verified date '2026-06-15' or the claude-code-version string '1.0.12' drawn from that file.
The response text names all six harness surfaces: .claude/agents/, .claude/skills/, .claude/rules/, .claude/hooks/, .github/workflows/, and CLAUDE.md.

The response text contains exactly five WOULD-DISPATCH lines, one for each fixed facet slug (models-tiering, cc-features-settings, agent-subagent-design, skills-context-engineering, hooks-lifecycle), and those five lines appear consecutively in the response text rather than separated by unrelated content.
The response text contains the string 'claude-sonnet-4-5', the exact model pin present in the seeded .claude/agents/code-implementer.md and tracker.
The response text contains no WOULD-RUN write lines targeting .claude/agents/, .claude/rules/, .claude/skills/, or .github/workflows/.

The response text contains a section presenting a per-facet remediation plan and states plan mode as the intended next step; for any facet whose external source could not be fetched, the response text labels that facet as unresolved or pending rather than asserting a confirmed-drift or clean-sweep verdict for it.
